paragraphs: Routeware sells digital technology for waste, recycling and heavy-duty fleet operations. The buyers are private haulers and municipal fleets. The software pulls collection, customer and business operations into one place.

Its routing product lets staff densify and edit routes and optimize entire fleets. Routes can be updated and stops reassigned in real time, with automatic sequencing. Dispatch gives a single view of orders, resources, status and inventory. Helper routes are built by drag and drop and resequenced on the spot. The back-office dispatch system is tied to the on-board computers in the truck.

The company describes the setup as hardware-light and cloud-based. It lists integrations with AWS, Esri, Geotab and Samsara. Some customers run several heavy-duty fleets, including snowplows and sweeper trucks. A separate product handles medical waste from end to end. Another is recycling software built around California mandates. The company says it has worked on digital transformation in waste and recycling for over twenty years.

quote.text: With the help of Routeware, costly complexity gives way to powerful simplicity.
